region_costa_desc: Peru's Pacific coastline is a paradise for seafood lovers. Centuries of fishing tradition meet Japanese, Chinese, and Spanish influences to create dishes like ceviche — the country's most iconic culinary treasure.
region_andes_desc: High in the mountains where potatoes were first cultivated, Andean cuisine is hearty, soulful, and rooted in Inca tradition. Purple potatoes, quinoa, and slow-cooked stews reflect thousands of years of agricultural ingenuity.
region_amazon_desc: The Amazon rainforest offers Peru's most adventurous flavors. Exotic fruits, river fish, and ingredients found nowhere else on earth are wrapped in banana leaves, infused with tropical herbs, and transformed into dishes as vibrant as the jungle itself.

privacy_intro: Peruvian Pot is a recipe showcase site. We collect minimal data to keep the site running and improve your experience.
privacy_data_text: When you leave a comment, we store the display name you provide. If you subscribe to our newsletter, we store your email address. We also collect anonymous usage data through cookies to understand how visitors use the site.
privacy_cookies_text: We use cookies for analytics and to remember your preferences (such as language choice and cookie consent). You can accept or decline non-essential cookies via the cookie banner, and reset your choice at any time from the footer.
privacy_third_party_text: We use Firebase (Google) for analytics, comment storage, and ratings. Google may process data according to their own privacy policy. No data is sold to third parties.
privacy_rights_text: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time. You can also decline cookies or unsubscribe from our newsletter.
